description:
Be a kernel gate: other procs send their requests to start or change procs to a mailbox of yours; a kernel station running on you holds each one, you are told, and you decide; the station forwards what you pass. One op per call:
- switch on: {"op": "on"} (prints the mailbox path; senders set AOS_KERNEL to it)
- held requests: {"op": "ls"}
- let one through: {"op": "pass", "letter": "<name>"} (the station forwards it and its rules still apply)
- refuse one: {"op": "refuse", "letter": "<name>", "reason": "one line for the sender"}
- switch off: {"op": "off"} (refuses what is still held)
Held requests reach you as a message "[aos] kernel_hold: ...". More: aos/kernel.json#/gate. Errors: ArgumentsBad, OpUnknown, LetterMissing, LetterRefused, PostFailed, WriteFailed, LaunchFailed, CommandFailed, DaemonMissing, DaemonFailed, InstanceMissing.

op.description: on = become a gate, off = stop, ls = held requests, pass = let one through, refuse = refuse one

letter.description: pass, refuse: the letter name from the notice or from ls

reason.description: refuse: one line the sender will read
